summary: Delete the developer turn budget (AISDLC-651.3) and the Step 6 parked outcome; no operator request or decision record authorized it

options.description: Delete everything: hook lib, test, collect-tool-sequence block, developer.md section, execute.md outcome, Step 6 parked branch and types, next-step/execute-host handling, replay fixture, scorecard turn fields (AISDLC-1463)
Keep the limit and fix the counter race, taskId resolution and parent-session leak

body: Planner audit 2026-11-27 after AISDLC-1454 stalled: the executor obeyed a TURN BUDGET REACHED notice meant for its developer subagent. Provenance: AISDLC-651.3 was agent-filed (PR #1148, 15034c274) claiming 'Operator-approved follow-up' with no quoted operator words; RFC-0050 does not ask for a cap; no decision record. The 120 default has no derivation (developer runs since 2026-10-11: median 20, p90 49, max 255; 5 of 2101 reached 120). It has never parked a task (no developer-parked outcome in local records). The counter is broken: bumpCount read-increment-writeFileSync races under parallel tool calls and resets to 1 (46 runs show drops); taskId is null in 96% of records. It is advisory only; run timeouts (system-runner timeoutMs SIGKILL), the Step 9 iteration cap, the budget pacer and the usage scorecard remain. Operator 2026-11-27: 'I never asked for it'; agreed to delete.
